info.title: Catasto
info.description:
This API provides structured access to official Italian real estate registry information related to **properties** and **subjects** (individuals and legal entities).

All POST endpoints provided by this API are asynchronous in the production environment. Each request is taken in charge and processed asynchronously. In the Sandbox environment, POST endpoints behave synchronously and return a simulated response intended solely for testing and integration purposes.

### **Dati Catastali**
The API allows consultation of the Italian Cadastre to retrieve detailed information about buildings and land plots and their registered holders. It is possible to:
- consult cadastral data for a specific property
- identify the registered holders of a property
- retrieve the list of properties owned by a physical or legal subject
- obtain detailed descriptions of properties associated with a subject
- determine the total number of land plots and buildings owned by a subject
- retrieve the list of properties located on a specific address

### **Visure Catastali**
The API includes the generation of cadastral views (Visure Catastali) for both properties and subjects. Visure Catastali can be obtained as official PDF documents, as XML documents, and as JSON documents. XML and JSON formats provide structured cadastral view data intended for software integration, automated processing, and data extraction.

### **Visure Ipotecarie**
The API includes access to **land registry searches (visure ipotecarie)**, which provide information about **registry entries (notes/formalities)** associated with properties or subjects, as recorded by the Italian Land Registry Offices (Conservatorie).
Through land registry search services it is possible to:
- identify the Land Registry Offices where a subject has
  registered entries (notes/formalities)
- retrieve the list of registry entries for a subject or property
  within a specific Land Registry Office
- obtain the detailed information of a single registry entry

### **Estratto Mappa**
Through this service you can get the PDF of the map extract from the land registry

### **Elaborato Planimetrico**
Through this service you can get the PDF of the cadastral building plan

### **Monitoraggio Catastale**
The API includes a cadastral monitoring system that allows you to create monitoring requests for properties and subjects. Monitoring can be configured for cadastral property data, province subject searches and national subject searches. If a callback is provided, the service notifies the configured callback URL when the first check is completed and whenever monitored fields change.

Callback.description: This is our standardized OpenAPI callback system. It enables the configuration of parameters for receiving notifications about status updates of asynchronous requests to this endpoint.

method.description: Specify the callback method. When set to 'POST', a standard HTTP POST request will be initiated with the Content-Type header set to application/x-www-form-urlencoded. The JSON data will be encoded into a key-value pair named data (customizable using the field parameter) within the request body. If the method is set to 'JSON', a direct HTTP POST request will be made with the Content-Type header set to application/json. The raw JSON data will be directly inserted into the request body without any encoding.

field.description: This parameter works in conjunction with the 'method' parameter set to 'POST'. When provided as a string, it determines the name of the parameter that will be sent in the POST request.

url.description: A valid URL capable of handling POST requests must be entered into this parameter. For endpoints requiring authentication, the 'headers' parameter can be used to specify 'basic auth' or 'bearer auth'. The maximum timeout is 30 seconds. If 'retry' is set, the system will retry up to 'retry' times until a 200 status code is received.

retry.description: The maximum number of attempts is defined by the 'retry' parameter. If the maximum number of attempts is reached without a successful status code (e.g., 200 OK), the request is considered a final failure. A time interval is often introduced between attempts to avoid overloading the server. This interval may increase exponentially with each attempt to reduce the impact on an overloaded server. The 'retry' parameter is configured to retry the request only in case of specific status codes, typically those indicating temporary errors (e.g., 502, 503) or network issues.

headers.description: A collection of HTTP headers to be sent with the request. Each header is defined as a key-value pair. Headers can be used for various purposes, including authentication, content negotiation, and custom metadata.

custom.description: This object can be populated with any additional data you wish to include in the callback response. This data will be accessible within the 'custom' parameter of the callback function. You can use this to store and retrieve any relevant information that you need for your application.

oneOf.description: Indicate through which method you want to receive data with the callback, by default it is POST

method.description: Indicate through which method you want to receive data with the callback, by default it is POST

field.description: Name of the field containing the callback return data

url.description: Url where the callback call will be made

data.description: Object to be completed at your convenience with additional data that you can use back with the callback

post.description:
This method allows you to create a request to receive information on subjects and properties in the Italian land registry.

 In some cases, the service may behave **synchronously** and return the **response immediately**.

• **elenco_immobili** – returns detailed information for each property (immobile) within the specified foglio and particella. Note: the sezione field is required only in municipalities that have sections; sezione_urbana is never required.

• **prospetto_catastale** – returns detailed information for each property (immobile) within the specified foglio, particella, and subalterno, including ownership (intestatari) details. Note: the sezione field is required only in municipalities that have sections; sezione_urbana is never required.


• **ricerca_persona** – returns basic information about the owner and the list of properties owned by that person or legal entity within the specified province. In some cases the list of properties may not be returned; when this occurs the subject may be returned with an empty immobili array, or the response may return no results with a message indicating that the search returns too many results.

 • **ricerca_nazionale** – Researches the properties owned by a subject  across the entire national territory.
  The result returns an aggregated overview by province and municipality, showing the number of buildings and land owned, without returning full property details.  

• **indirizzo** – returns the list of properties (with full details) associated with a given address identifier (**id_indirizzo**) obtained via POST/indirizzo (**asynchronous**) or GET /indirizzo (**synchronous**).
In some cases, for the address to return valid results, it is necessary to also specify the street number (civic number) together with the address. If the civic number is missing, sometimes the system may not be able to correctly associate any property to the given address.

post.description:
Create a request to obtain a Visura Catastale (property or subject).

• By property (**entita: immobile**)

  - With id_immobile: the request is performed directly using the property identifier.

  - Without id_immobile: the request is performed using the available cadastral data.

• By subject (**entita: soggetto**)

  - With id_soggetto: provincia is optional. If provided, the visura is performed for that province; if omitted, the visura is performed for the first available province returned for that subject.

  - Without id_soggetto: the request is performed using the available subject data.

• **Homonyms:** if more than one subject is registered under the same cf_piva (e.g. after a change of company legal form), a request without id_soggetto returns only the visura of the **first subject found**. To obtain the visura of every subject, first call **POST /richiesta/ricerca_nazionale** with the cf_piva: the response lists all matching subjects, each with its own **id_soggetto**. Then call **POST /visura_catastale** once for each subject, passing its **id_soggetto**.

• **tipo_visura** can be "ordinaria" or "storica".

• **tipo_dettaglio** can be "sintetica" or "analitica".

For subjects, if **tipo_dettaglio** is omitted, the Visura Catastale will be "sintetica" by default.

For properties, if **tipo_dettaglio** is omitted, the Visura Catastale "storica" will be "analitica" by default. The Visura Catastale "ordinaria" is always complete, so **tipo_dettaglio** is ignored.

• **tipo_formato** is optional and can be **"pdf"**, **"xml"** or **"json"**.

If **tipo_formato** is omitted, the document will be generated in PDF format by default.

Use **tipo_formato: "xml"** to request the Visura Catastale in XML format.

Use **tipo_formato: "json"** to request the Visura Catastale in JSON format.

XML and JSON follow the same rules.

For subject requests (**entita: soggetto**), XML and JSON are available only with **tipo_visura: "ordinaria"** and **tipo_dettaglio: "analitica"**.

For property requests (**entita: immobile**), XML and JSON are available with **tipo_visura: "ordinaria"**, or with **tipo_visura: "storica"** when **tipo_dettaglio** is **"analitica"** or **omitted**.

For XML and JSON documents, the response includes a **risultato** field containing the Visura Catastale body.

The response returns a **request id**. Check status with **GET /visura_catastale/{id}** and download the document with **GET /visura_catastale/{id}/documento** when available.

The downloaded document will be returned as **PDF**, **XML**, or **JSON**.

post.description:
With this endpoint you can create a new cadastral monitoring request. If you have set a callback, you will be notified when the first check is completed and every time one or more monitored fields change. The first check may be completed within a few seconds. If the result is not immediately available, the monitoring request will be processed automatically. Subsequent checks take place every 7 days for:
  • prospetto_catastale
  • ricerca_persona
  • ricerca_nazionale
If rinnovo_automatico is omitted, it is set to true. For prospetto_catastale, campi_monitorati can be omitted to monitor all fields, set to all, or populated with one or more allowed fields. For ricerca_persona and ricerca_nazionale, monitored fields are always saved as all. The esito field can also return Nessun risultato trovato. For ricerca_persona and ricerca_nazionale, if no subject data is found during the first check, ultimo_dataset and dataset_precedente are returned as null. If data was found in a previous check and a later check no longer finds any related properties or cadastral records, esito remains Nessun risultato trovato; in this case the dataset keeps the subject structure, but the immobili array for ricerca_persona or the catasti array for ricerca_nazionale is returned empty. For prospetto_catastale, when no data is found, dataset fields are returned as null.

Endpoint that returns the monitoring request identified by the id passed in the path.

In the test environment, you can use the optional callback query parameter to synchronously simulate the periodic monitoring check normally executed by the system cron. This lets you test the verification flow and, if a callback URL is configured on the monitoring request, receive the simulated callback response.
